purpose: Accepted debt for preflight Check 14 (roadmap-coverage): requirements that have shipped code but no Backlog Items row in docs/roadmap/ROADMAP.md. Shrink-only — an entry may be removed when its row is written, and may never be added to silence a new finding.

notes.legacy-debt: These requirements predate this check: shell, navigation, scope-routing, knowledge-pilot and related work from the era when the roadmap tracked phases rather than individual requirements. Several were invisible to an earlier draft of this check, which counted a mention in a Dependencies cell or a Phases goal as ownership - it is not, and removing that leniency made the real debt visible rather than creating it. Each needs a row under its owning phase; none is a defect in the code.
notes.removed-2026-08-28: FR-114, FR-115 and FR-116 left this list because PR #142 wrote their rows - the ratchet working as intended. FR-071 left it for a WEAKER reason and the distinction matters: it is now credited because TASK-FR-115 and TASK-FR-116 each NAME FR-071 in their titles, referring to what FR-071 owns, not because any row accounts for FR-071 itself. It still has no row. See the limitation recorded in scripts/roadmap-coverage.mjs: a title mention can over-credit, so this check is a LOWER BOUND on missing rows, never an exact set.
